messages:
Leo (AM): Heads-up — Banyan analytics team says they're migrating internal notebooks into Redwood this quarter. They want programmatic generation + long-context summaries. New use-cases: nightly batch summarization + interactive notebooks. Possible 5–10x qps peak. Any concerns?

Maria (CS): Nice, which teams? data-science or platform?

Leo (AM): 3 squads: Research, BI, and a new "Insights SDK" team building product features. Riley is the main contact.

Riley (Customer Success): Yep, I'm coordinating. They plan to onboard next month. Need an onboarding workshop + quota bump request. Also worried about cost impact on renewal (EOM). Can we model cost for expected qps?

Aj (Solutions): Quick ask — what's the expected token distribution per request? avg tokens / max tokens?

Riley (Customer Success): They estimated avg 800 tokens (summaries), up to 4k for long dumps. Batch jobs will do 200 requests hourly; interactive ~15 req/s during peak.

Sam (Prod Eng): 15 r/s w/ 4k tokens is nontrivial. Recommend Dedicated pilot or autoscaling burst. Also suggest prefix/KV caching for notebook context. We can simulate with load test.

Maria (CS): I'll open a quota ticket. @eng-sre any capacity constraints EU-west?

eng-sre-bot: Capacity check scheduled. Predicted 90% capacity on standard shared fleet for evening windows. Recommend Dedicated or reserved burst.

Aj (Solutions): For cost modeling, try `gpt-medium-q4` vs quantized variant. Toy calc: 15r/s * 3600s * 200 rows ~ hm. Let's get exact numbers in a quick spreadsheet.

Leo (AM): Also: product asks for 99th pct latency <= 500ms for interactive. Can we hit that with batching/caching?

Sam (Prod Eng): 500ms at 4k tokens is tough on shared. With Dedicated + kernel selection + dynamic batching probably yes. We'll need to pin model and enable KV cache. I'll run a perf sim.

Riley (Customer Success): I'll loop in the finance lead to estimate renewal impact. Also scheduling onboarding: week of Apr 14? Prefer Mon/Tues workshops.

Maria (CS): Created ticket CS-4829 for quota + onboarding. Linking notes: https://redwood.atlassian.com/CS-4829

Leo (AM): Thanks. Can someone own the perf sim and a short price estimate by EOD Friday? If not, mark as follow-up for next week.

Sam (Prod Eng): I can own perf sim. ETA Friday EOD. Will post logs + recommended config.

Aj (Solutions): I'll draft a cost model and two path options: Shared+Burst (cheaper) and Dedicated (predictable).

Riley (Customer Success): Great. Also capturing feature feedback: they want tool-calling to fetch internal dbs from notebook code. I'll make a feature ticket.

Maria (CS): :thumbsup: tagging @legal for data usage clarification (notebooks may include PII).

Legal-bot: Legal review requested. Please provide dataflow diagram and retention policy.

Leo (AM): OK — we'll collect and send. Thanks everyone.

Sam (Prod Eng): Posting perf sim plan:
```
- sim load: 15 rps interactive, 200/hr batch
- model: gpt-medium-q4 + quantized variant
- metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU util, cost/token
```

Sam (Prod Eng): I'll upload results under CS/clients/banyan once done.

Riley (Customer Success): Follow-up sync scheduled Thu 10am PT. Invite sent.

Leo (AM): Closing note: renewal risk low if we show cost + SLA plan. Keep updates in this thread.
